content.short: Bored Candy City is a Cronos DEX with NFT marketplace and play-to-earn games.
content.description: Bored Candy City is a Cronos Chain–based DEX that returns 100% of swap fees to liquidity providers. It also runs an NFT marketplace where listing and trading fees are distributed as rewards to holders, so users benefit from activity on the platform. In addition, the project hosts a play-to-earn games hub with three live titles, one of which is listed in the App Store & Play Store. Players earn game credits through the games and can convert those credits to real money.
